items.title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
items.summary: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating, and at today’s prices each one earns slightly more than the electricity it burns.

items.title: Binance CFO steps down nine days after record hack; co-CEO says transition was planned six months ago
items.summary: Co-CEO Yi He said Ng is departing to pursue a new venture, under a transition plan put in place over the past six months.
